_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Interior cabinet repaint — HIGHEST COMPLEXITY interior RP spec. Combined prime + finish for previously painted or factory-finished interior cabinets in occupied homes. Context prefix CBRP (CaBinet RePaint) confirmed collision-free. TSK_CABT_* is NC cabinet (SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT_v1, 58 tasks). TSK_DIRP_* is interior door RP. TSK_TMRP_* is trim RP. TSK_WLRP_* is wall RP. TSK_CLRP_* is ceiling RP. TSK_WNRP_* is window RP. TSK_STRP_* is stair RP. Verified: zero TSK_CBRP_* IDs exist in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet door face
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Same physical item in RP context. Removed, painted flat on sawhorses. Style complexity via door_style modifier (slab, shaker, raised_panel, glass_frame).

paintable_items.name: Cabinet drawer front face
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Same physical item in RP context. Removed, painted flat on sawhorses. ~0.7x door time per unit.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet face frame and exposed box surfaces
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Includes stiles, rails, end panels, toe kicks, filler strips. Painted in-place after doors/drawers removed. Conditional on scope = full_exterior or full_with_interior.

paintable_items.name: Cabinet box interior surfaces
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT. Conditional on scope = full_with_interior. Always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard). Spray-only in practice.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_CABT_* is NC cabinet (SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT_v1, 58 tasks). TSK_DIRP_* is interior door RP. TSK_TMRP_* is trim RP. TSK_WLRP_* is wall RP. TSK_CLRP_* is ceiling RP. TSK_WNRP_* is window RP. TSK_STRP_* is stair RP. TSK_DRRP_* is exterior door RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — CBRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_CBRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (ASSESS_CONDITION, ASSESS_ADHESION, ASSESS_COATING_ID, ASSESS_MOISTURE, ASSESS_THERMOFOIL, ASSESS_LEAD, GREASE_WASH, DEGLOSS_FRAMES, DEGLOSS_DOORS, DEGLOSS_DRAWERS, DEGLOSS_CHEMICAL, DEGLOSS_INTERIOR, SCRAPE_LOOSE, FEATHER_EDGES, DAMAGE_REPAIR, TREAT_MILDEW, TREAT_SMOKE, PRIME_FRAMES, PRIME_DOORS, PRIME_DRAWERS, PRIME_INTERIOR, PRIME_ADHESION_TEST, SPRAY_FRAMES, BRUSH_FRAMES, SPRAY_DOORS, BRUSH_DOORS, SPRAY_DRAWERS, BRUSH_DRAWERS, SPRAY_INTERIOR, etc.). ALL tasks in this combined RP spec use the CBRP_ prefix — both RP-new tasks and tasks adapted from NC cabinet spec. Direct NC task transfers are re-issued under TSK_CBRP_* for prefix consistency.

expected_modules.notes: Floor protection (full kitchen spray / perimeter brush), countertop protection, backsplash masking, wall masking (spray), ceiling masking (spray), appliance protection (ALWAYS in RP), hardware removal (scored/extracted for painted-over RP hardware), door/drawer removal, cabinet contents verification, plumbing/electrical masking. Method-dependent protection scope.

RP-SPECIFIC: condition inspect (all components), adhesion test (ASTM D3359 cross-hatch), coating identification (solvent test — mineral spirits/xylene/denatured alcohol/acetone), moisture check (base cabinets, bath vanity), thermofoil assessment gate (if applicable — go/no-go), lead screening (pre-1978 conditional). Assessment maps to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. 5-6 FIXED time tasks.

TSP/degreaser wash (kitchen grease — RP-NEW, replaces NC dust clean), mechanical degloss (frames SF, doors EA, drawers EA, interior SF), chemical degloss (profiled doors — optional for raised_panel/shaker), scrape loose/failing paint (FAIR/POOR), feather-sand scrape edges (FAIR/POOR), damage repair (dings/scratches — replaces NC fill), caulk assess/replace (modified from NC full caulk — assess existing, replace 15-30% failed sections), mildew biocide treatment (moisture damage conditional), smoke pre-treatment wash (smoke damage conditional), vacuum/dust removal.

State-driven + factory-finish-type-driven primer: SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT (painted_oil, failing, peeling), SYS_PRIMER_BONDING_FACTORY (factory lacquer, catalyzed varnish, thermofoil), SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT (smoke damage — shellac BIN), SYS_PRIMER_MILDEW_INT (moisture damage with mildew). Conditional on substrate_state + factory_finish_type. Includes post-primer adhesion test (quality gate for bonding primer). Brush/spray variants for each item type.

Fine-finish interstage protocol at all tiers: inspect coat, light sand between coats (QT3 spot 220, QT4 full 220, QT5 thorough 220-320), patch/repair defects, spot coat patches, clean dust/tack. Runs between each coat pair. Separate tasks for frames (SF), doors (EA), drawers (EA), interior (SF). Universal for cabinets — scrutinized surface.

Finish coat application — spray or brush. Frame tasks (SF) + door tasks (EA) + drawer tasks (EA) + interior tasks (SF, spray-only). 2 coats standard (QT3-QT4), 3 coats QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3. Fine-finish coating systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). Interstage between coats.

Final inspection, touch-up, cure period (5-7 day minimum — SEPARATE MOBILIZATION), hardware reinstallation (may need mortise cleaning for paint build-up), door/drawer reinstallation, alignment verification, soft-close operation check, protection teardown (countertop, backsplash, wall, ceiling, floor, appliance), vacuum, tool cleanup, contents replacement coordination (homeowner), customer walkthrough (RP-specific).

Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all interior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. Cabinets are HIGH RISK for lead paint — oil-based enamel with lead pigment was standard on kitchen cabinetry through the 1970s.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of cabinet door faces to be painted. Each face counted separately.
Count of cabinet drawer front faces to be painted.
Total SF of face frame and exposed box surfaces (stiles, rails, end panels, toe kicks, filler strips). Required when scope = full_exterior or full_with_interior.
Total SF of cabinet interior surfaces. Required when scope = full_with_interior.
Total hardware piece count (hinges + pulls + knobs) for removal/reinstall labor. RP rate is slower than NC due to painted-over hardware.
Total LF of cabinet-to-wall caulk joints for assessment/replacement. RP assesses existing caulk and replaces only failed sections (15-30%).
Room count for setup/cleanup, assessment, and FIXED-time tasks.
Floor area requiring protection in cabinet work zone. RP always has finished floors.
Perimeter floor protection for brush method. Required when application_method = brush.
Countertop surface area requiring protection. CRITICAL: high-value surfaces. Always installed in RP.
Linear footage of backsplash requiring masking. Always present in RP kitchen.
Wall area requiring masking for spray overspray protection. Walls always finished in RP — masking is mandatory for spray.
Ceiling area requiring masking for spray overspray protection.
Number of appliances requiring protection. ALWAYS required in RP (was conditional/atypical in NC). Appliances are always present in occupied homes.
Post-work vacuum cleanup area.
Height classification for frame tasks. Most kitchens are standard 8ft but tall kitchens (9-12ft) require step ladder/scaffold for upper cabinet work.
Surface condition enum (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for condition modifier selection. Values from condition_scale enum.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with all interior RP specs (proposed first in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP). RP-specific condition assessment driving prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Interior substrate state classification (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE). Drives primer selection logic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with all interior RP specs (proposed first in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP). Distinct from SURFACE_CONDITION which drives prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with all interior RP specs. Cabinets are HIGH RISK for lead paint — oil-based enamel with lead pigment.

paintscope_keys.description: Contamination type: none, mildew, smoke, water_stain, grease. Drives treatment task activation and primer selection.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with all interior RP specs. Cabinets add 'grease' as a contamination type (kitchen-specific).

paintscope_keys.description: Existing factory finish type on cabinets: painted_latex, painted_oil, lacquer, thermofoil, catalyzed_varnish, unknown. Drives primer routing logic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Cabinet-specific — not shared with other RP specs. Cabinet RP is the only spec requiring factory finish identification as an assessment dimension.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating thermofoil/vinyl-wrapped cabinet doors. Triggers assessment gate and modified prep workflow.
paintscope_keys.notes: Cabinet-specific. Thermofoil requires special handling (adhesion gate, mechanical scuff only, no chemical degloss).

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — cabinets are a fine-finish surface per NC convention. QT3 is minimum for cabinets. QT modifiers: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.30x, QT5=1.50x. Cabinet interiors always QT3 regardless of exterior tier (AWI semi-exposed standard).

application_method.notes: Spray strongly preferred per Fine Finish Doctrine SS10.3 and SS15.1.2. Brush method uses Roll and Tip technique per SS15.6. Cabinet interiors are spray-only in practice. Roll is NOT valid for cabinets. spray_backroll not applicable. 'brush' means Roll and Tip methodology.

sheen.notes: Semi-gloss is kitchen/bath standard for cleanability. Satin at QT3+. Semi-gloss at QT4+. Gloss at QT5 only. Flat/matte/eggshell NOT valid for cabinets per Fine_Finish_Doctrine.

phase.notes: Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. 'apply' omitted from values because spec uses prime/finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA for door/drawer tasks and hardware tasks. SF for frame/interior tasks. LF for caulk/backsplash masking. EA_ROOM for per-room heuristics. FIXED for assessment, grease wash, and customer walkthrough.

substrate_state.notes: All 5 interior RP substrate states accepted. Output normalizes to standard SS_PAINTED_* per selected sheen. Semi-gloss is default cabinet sheen. Different cabinet components (frames, doors, interiors) may have different substrate states — assess per component.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale per controlled_enums.json. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.5x (higher than door/trim RP 2.0x because cabinet failure remediation involves multiple item types and orientations).

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for cabinet RP. 'tool' covers screw extractor, assessment kit. 'prep' covers TSP degreaser, chemical deglosser, biocide.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven + factory-finish-type-driven RP primers. Finish = fine-finish QT-driven systems. Specialty = shellac stain blocker, biocide, wood hardener.

yield_uom.notes: EA for per-door/drawer consumables. SF for coverage-based consumables. LF for caulk yield. GAL for product yield.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for floor_perimeter (brush). full_cover for floor_full_kitchen (spray), countertop_covers, wall_adjacent_cabinet (spray), appliance_covers. partial_cover for backsplash_mask. item_mask for cabinet_hardware. light_mask for plumbing_electrical.

floor_type.notes: RP ALWAYS has finished floors. Subfloor and partial not applicable to interior RP.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT4=selective_multiplier (1.30x on qt_scaled tasks), QT5=selective_multiplier (1.50x) + additional_rounds (coat 3 brush per FFD 15.10.3).

surface_ids.primary_surface_note: cabinet_face_frame is representative for frame component. cabinet_door is primary for door component. cabinet_drawer for drawer. cabinet_box_interior for interiors. All are existing surface IDs.
surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs are existing in id_registry.json surface_ids entries_in_active_use. cabinet_face_frame, cabinet_door, cabinet_drawer, cabinet_box_interior, cabinet_end_panel all registered. wall_field and ceiling_field are standard adjacent surfaces. countertop and backsplash are cabinet-specific adjacent surfaces (always present in RP, high-value protection).

zone_ids.notes: Full kitchen floor coverage for cabinet spray work. Canvas drop cloths + tape edges. RP always has finished floors. Spray method only.
Drop cloth runners at cabinet base. Brush drip and sanding dust protection. Brush method only.
CRITICAL: high-value surfaces (granite, quartz, marble). Always installed in RP. Kraft/rosin paper + plastic for spray. Paper + tape for brush.
Tile backsplash masking between counter and upper cabinets. Always present in RP kitchen.
Plastic sheeting on walls for spray overspray. In RP, walls are ALWAYS finished — masking is mandatory for spray. Spray method only.
Ceiling fixtures and under-cabinet lighting near spray work area. Includes ceiling masking for spray method.
Full appliance wrap. RP MODIFICATION: always present in RP (was conditional/atypical in NC). Appliances are always installed in occupied homes.
Hardware removed, bagged, and labeled. RP adds scoring/extraction complexity for painted-over hardware. Rate ~30-50% slower than NC.
Plumbing fixtures in sink base cabinet (pipes, valves). Electrical outlets/switches — plates removed and bagged. Under-cabinet lighting masked. Used in NC spec but not yet registered as a zone_id.

RP-NEW: Cabinet contents must be emptied before painting. Homeowner typically handles emptying. Painter verifies all cabinets are empty. Contents staging area protected and organized for reinstallation after cure. Does not exist in NC.

material_system_prefix.notes: Three fine-finish systems (QT3/QT4/QT5) are existing shared systems used across all fine-finish specs. SYS_PRIMER_BONDING is existing from NC cabinet spec — reusable for factory-primed substrate bonding. Four RP primer systems are proposed (shared with other interior RP specs — proposed first in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP and SF_DOOR_INT_RP): adhesion for painted surfaces, bonding for factory lacquer/thermofoil/catalyzed varnish, stain-block for smoke damage, mildew for moisture damage. SYS_PRIMER_BONDING_FACTORY is a new proposal distinct from NC SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — RP uses bonding primer for factory lacquer/thermofoil/catalyzed varnish rather than for factory-primed new construction substrates. Materials Manager to evaluate whether SYS_PRIMER_BONDING can be reused with different routing logic or if a distinct SYS_ ID is needed.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Chemical degloss for existing paint. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: RP Assessment Kit (Adhesion + Coating ID)
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Cross-hatch cutter, tape (ASTM D3359), mineral spirits, xylene, denatured alcohol, white rags. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_DOOR_INT_RP resolution. Surface decontamination wash. Cabinet RP uses for kitchen grease removal (primary use case).

proposed_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Chemical Deglosser (Wilbond, Krud Kutter Gloss-Off)
proposed_consumables.justification: Alternative to mechanical sanding for profiled cabinet doors (raised panel, shaker) where sandpaper cannot reach all recessed areas. NOT applicable to thermofoil (solvents damage vinyl). May share function with CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID — Materials Manager to evaluate if separate ID is needed or if CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID suffices.

proposed_consumables.name: Screw Extractor Set
proposed_consumables.justification: For painted-over stripped screws on cabinet hardware. Conditional on RP hardware removal difficulty. Not used in NC (new hardware, clean screws).

proposed_consumables.name: Mildew Biocide Treatment Spray
proposed_consumables.justification: For SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE under-sink and bath vanity cabinets with mildew. Conditional on moisture damage + mildew present. May share with other RP specs.

proposed_consumables.name: Pin-Type Moisture Meter
proposed_consumables.justification: For moisture assessment on base cabinet floors, back walls, and bath vanity surrounds. Tool is reusable — shared across cabinet RP projects.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Standard RP sequence for FAIR/POOR condition cabinets or factory lacquer/thermofoil/oil substrates requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Most common RP round for cabinets with adhesion, contamination, or factory finish issues. Prime coat is state-driven + factory-finish-type-driven (adhesion, bonding, stain-block, or mildew primer). Also applies to GOOD condition with painted_oil or factory lacquer/thermofoil (primer always required for these finishes regardless of condition).

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only. GOOD condition, no prime needed — sound paint with adhesion verified, existing finish is latex.
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when: adhesion test passes, existing paint is sound, existing coating is field-applied latex (not oil, not factory lacquer/thermofoil). Simplest and fastest RP round — cosmetic color change scenario.

proposed_rounds.description: Prime + 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition or factory finish requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Maximum coat sequence for cabinets. State-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats with thorough interstage at 220-320 grit. 4 total coats, 3 interstage cycles.

proposed_rounds.description: 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush + GOOD condition + latex existing.
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat per FFD 15.10.3 even without prime. 3 total coats, 2 interstage cycles.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for adhesion primer on previously painted cabinet surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less primer than bare wood. Expect 400-500 SF-equivalent/gal for frames, similar to door RP coverage.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for bonding primer on factory lacquer/thermofoil/catalyzed varnish cabinet surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Factory finish surfaces are non-porous — bonding primer coverage is higher (less absorption). Expect 450-550 SF-equivalent/gal.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for shellac stain blocker on smoke-damaged cabinet surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Shellac primers have lower coverage than latex. Expect 250-350 SF-equivalent/gal.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for fine-finish enamel on repainted cabinet surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar to NC fine-finish coverage. Previously painted substrate has slightly better absorption than bare wood. Materials Manager to evaluate if NC coverage profiles can be reused.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared across interior RP specs. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.5x (cabinet-specific POOR is higher than door/trim RP 2.0x due to multi-item type remediation complexity).
Shared across interior RP specs. Drives treatment task activation and primer selection. Cabinets add 'grease' as contamination type.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfers from NC unchanged. slab=1.00x, shaker=1.15x, raised_panel=1.30x, glass_frame=1.20x. Applied per EA for door/drawer tasks. In RP, raised_panel complexity is AMPLIFIED because existing finish in recessed areas is harder to degloss.
Transfers from NC unchanged. standard_8ft=1.00x, tall_9_10ft=1.15x, extra_tall_11_12ft=1.30x. Applies to frame tasks ONLY — doors/drawers painted at ground level on sawhorses.

Transfers from NC unchanged. simple=1.00x, standard=1.10x, complex=1.20x, very_complex=1.30x. Applies to protection tasks, frame painting tasks, caulk tasks, and RP-specific grease clean tasks. Does NOT apply to door/drawer tasks.

prep_pool.formula: condition_modifier x door_style_modifier x height_modifier (frame tasks) x kitchen_complexity_modifier (frame/protection tasks)
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.5) x raised_panel(1.30) x extra_tall(1.30) x very_complex(1.30) = 5.49x
prep_pool.flag_note: EXCEEDS 4.0x threshold. However, POOR + raised_panel + extra_tall + very_complex is an extremely rare combination. Realistic max (no very_complex): POOR(2.5) x raised_panel(1.30) x standard_8ft(1.00) x standard(1.10) = 3.58x. Flag for estimator review if any combination exceeds 4.0x but allow with warning — POOR condition cabinets genuinely require 2.5x+ prep effort.

coating_pool.formula: qt_modifier x door_style_modifier x height_modifier (frame tasks) x kitchen_complexity_modifier (frame tasks)
coating_pool.max_theoretical: QT5(1.50) x raised_panel(1.30) x extra_tall(1.30) x very_complex(1.30) = 3.29x
coating_pool.flag_note: Under 4.0x — valid. Same as NC maximum.

coordination_notes: Cabinet RP runs alongside trim RP (SF_TRIM_INT_RP) which covers door casing and baseboard in kitchen. Sequencing: trim first, then cabinets (or same session if same color). Shared consumables and protection overlap.
Cabinet RP may run alongside wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP) in full kitchen repaint. Sequencing: cabinets and trim before walls per fine-finish-first principle.
Wall masking for cabinet spray (wall_adjacent_cabinet zone) may already be in place from wall RP — coordination avoids duplicate protection setup.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks.
Cabinet RP is typically scheduled LAST among interior RP specs to minimize dust contamination on wet cabinet finishes (same principle as NC).
Countertop, backsplash, and appliance protection zones are unique to cabinet RP — no coordination needed with other specs for these zones.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Cabinet Repaint (Combined Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for interior cabinet repaint. Covers all 4 NC cabinet items (door EA, drawer EA, frame SF, interior SF conditional) in RP context. No existing SF_ covers interior cabinet RP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Cabinet Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix CBRP for interior cabinet RP tasks (~68-78 tasks). Avoids collision with TSK_CABT_* (NC cabinet, 58 tasks), TSK_DIRP_* (interior door RP), TSK_TMRP_* (trim RP), TSK_WLRP_* (wall RP), TSK_CLRP_* (ceiling RP), TSK_WNRP_* (window RP), TSK_STRP_* (stair RP), TSK_DRRP_* (exterior door RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Cabinet Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 7 CBRP modules (setup, assess, prep, prime, interstage, finish, cleanup) + shared MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Cabinet RP: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific round with conditional state-driven + factory-finish-type-driven prime. Not equivalent to NC ROUND_CABT_PRIME_2FINISH (NC substrate-driven prime).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Cabinet RP: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP GOOD condition round with latex existing — skip prime when adhesion verified. Distinct from NC ROUND_CABT_2FINISH because RP context has different preconditions (condition assessment vs substrate state).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Cabinet RP: Prime + 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maximum coat sequence for QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition or factory finish requiring primer.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Cabinet RP: 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush, No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT5 brush 3-coat sequence for GOOD condition with latex existing. No prime needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adhesion Primer Coverage on Painted Cabinet Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — adhesion primer on previously painted cabinets differs from bare-wood primer coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bonding Primer Coverage on Factory Lacquer/Thermofoil/Catalyzed Varnish
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Coverage rate for bonding primer on non-porous factory finish surfaces. Higher coverage than porous substrates.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Shellac Stain Blocker Coverage on Cabinet Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Shellac primers have distinct (lower) coverage rate from latex/adhesion primers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fine-Finish Enamel Coverage on Repainted Cabinet Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific finish coverage — slightly different absorption on previously painted substrate vs bare. Materials Manager to evaluate if NC coverage profiles can be reused.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Adhesion Primer for Previously Painted Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific primer for painted_oil substrates, SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT, and SS_INT_PEELING conditions. Shared with all interior RP specs (proposed first in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP / SF_DOOR_INT_RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bonding Primer for Factory Lacquer/Catalyzed Varnish/Thermofoil
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Cabinet RP-specific primer for factory finish surfaces that are extremely hard/slick. Same product family as SYS_PRIMER_BONDING (Stix, XIM UMA, Extreme Bond) but different routing logic — RP routes by factory_finish_type, NC routes by bare substrate type.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Stain Blocker for Smoke/Nicotine/Water Damage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific shellac stain blocker (BIN) for smoke damage encapsulation and water stain blocking. Shared with all interior RP specs (proposed first in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP / SF_DOOR_INT_RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Mildew-Resistant Primer for Moisture-Damaged Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific mildew-resistant primer for under-sink cabinets and bath vanities with mildew/mold history. Shared with all interior RP specs (proposed first in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP / SF_DOOR_INT_RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Liquid Sander / Chemical Deglosser (Wilbond, Krud Kutter Gloss-Off)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Alternative to mechanical sanding for profiled cabinet doors. May share function with CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID — Materials Manager to evaluate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Screw Extractor Set
registry_additions_proposed.justification: For painted-over stripped screws on cabinet hardware. RP-conditional. Not used in NC.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Mildew Biocide Treatment Spray
registry_additions_proposed.justification: For SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE under-sink and bath vanity cabinets. Conditional on moisture damage + mildew present.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Pin-Type Moisture Meter
registry_additions_proposed.justification: For moisture assessment on base cabinet floors, back walls, and bath vanity surrounds. Reusable tool shared across projects.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Existing Factory Finish Type on Cabinets
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Cabinet RP-specific assessment dimension. Values: painted_latex, painted_oil, lacquer, thermofoil, catalyzed_varnish, unknown. Not shared with other RP specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Thermofoil/Vinyl-Wrapped Cabinet Doors Present
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Cabinet RP-specific boolean flag for thermofoil assessment gate and modified prep workflow.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Factory Finish Type Input
